tools.name: pw_health
tools.description: Liveness check for the Perimeter Watch API. Returns ok, service, version. Call first to verify connectivity before pw_snapshot.

tools.name: pw_snapshot
tools.description:
Run a free one-time external-perimeter scan on a domain you control.

Checks TLS certificate expiry, domain renewal status, dangling CNAME
takeover risk, and CT-log lookalike domains. Returns a rating plus
per-check detail. NOT idempotent (each call consumes rate limit);
takes 20-60s; rate-limited t

tools.name: pw_watch_status
tools.description:
Check whether a domain is enrolled on a paid weekly monitoring plan.

Returns enrollment status. Paid plans add weekly re-scans with email
briefs. Read-only lookup.

Args:
    domain: the domain to look up (e.g. example.com)

tools.name: pw_stats
tools.description: Service funnel counters: page views, snapshots run, paid registrations. Read-only.

tools.name: skills_list_tool
tools.description:
List this product's skills. Each entry carries the SKILL.md URI,
its name and description, verbatim frontmatter, and a per-file
sha256 manifest. Read a body with `read_skill`.

tools.name: read_skill
tools.description:
Read a product skill file by its skill:// URI.

Args:
    uri: e.g. skill://<product>/<skill-name>/SKILL.md
         Get valid URIs from `skills_list_tool`.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pw_watch_status · Private data: skills_list_tool, read_skill · Public sink: pw_watch_status · Destructive: pw_snapshot, pw_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pw_watch_status · Private data: skills_list_tool, read_skill · Public sink: pw_watch_status · Destructive: pw_snapshot, pw_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
